questions.label: Unusable now
questions.question: Is the equipment currently unable to perform its intended job?
questions.yes: The current fault prevents normal operation.
questions.no: It operates normally, or only a past fault is described.

questions.label: Getting worse
questions.question: Is the current equipment fault deteriorating?
questions.yes: The report describes a worsening fault, even if equipment still operates.
questions.no: There is no current deterioration, or the problem is only historical.

questions.label: Repair verified
questions.question: Has a lasting repair of the current fault been verified?
questions.yes: A repair is complete and has passed a sustained operation check.
questions.no: A restart, temporary workaround, hope, or unverified claim is not a verified repair.

text: It's running again after the third reset. Pressure is dropping faster each time. We haven't replaced anything or checked the repair.
